chunks: Abū al-Ḥasan (peace be upon him) said, 'Verily I seek forgiveness from Allah five thousand times every day.' Then he said to me, 'Five thousand is a lot.'
ai.seo_question: How many times did Imam al-Kazim seek forgiveness daily?
ai.summary: Imām al-Kāẓim (peace be upon him) narrates that he seeks forgiveness from Allah five thousand times daily, yet he remarks to his companion that even this immense volume is 'too much,' highlighting the infinite nature of divine mercy and the believer's perpetual need for repentance. This hadith, found in *Kitab al-Zuhd*, underscores the Shia emphasis on *istighfar* not merely as a ritual but as a continuous spiritual state, where the servant never feels their devotion is sufficient before the All-Forgiving. It serves as a practical model for the faithful to maintain constant humility and awareness of their spiritual standing.
